method: Actual public slide viewers inspected through browser screenshots; text metadata is separate. No photograph, thumbnail or screenshot is retained in the workspace or embedded in the app.

observations.observedAndLimitations: Human thin skin; real tissue section opened. Does not by itself establish every epidermal stratum, elastin fibre, sensory receptor or hypodermal structure in the composite plates.
Human scalp; longitudinal follicles/bulbs and sebaceous glands visible. No claim that the overview resolves the complete papilla, sebaceous duct and arrector-pili combination.
Human thick skin with a Pacinian corpuscle; no nail apparatus in the inspected field. Rejected as a nail-section match.
Human spleen section; red/white pulp visible. Central arteriole, marginal-zone boundary, individual sinusoids and cords were not all resolved in the overview.
Human thymus; lobules, cortex and medulla visible. Hassall corpuscles and anterior chest/retrosternal placement not established by this overview.
Human adrenal section with cortex and medulla; not an in-situ adrenal-on-kidney photograph and not cell-level verification of every cortical zone/chromaffin cell.
Human ileal cross-section, villi and lymphoid tissue visible. The 2x overview does not resolve individual columnar epithelial cells, all crypt-cell types or the paired longitudinal wall view.
Human ovary: a corpus luteum and several follicular profiles visible. Does not establish a complete developmental sequence or all oocyte-wall structures at cell level.
Human ovary with cortical follicular profiles and medullary vessels. No assertion that all primordial-to-mature stages, corona radiata and zona pellucida were individually resolved.
Human uterine tissue with endometrial glands and myometrium visible; a low-power section, not independent verification of the perimetrium and every endometrial sublayer.
Human secretory uterine tissue with glandular profiles and muscle visible. Useful companion to proliferative tissue; not proof that every wall layer in the composite is covered.

additionalInspection: Human kidney-cortex Commons photograph reopened at cell-resolving displayed size; reused for cuboidal epithelium.
